qc.title: Look closer before you ship.
qc.intro: QC photos help you review the item that reached the warehouse. Keep them separate from seller photos, and connect every image to the exact order and option.

sections.heading: Seller photos and QC answer different questions
paragraphs: A seller gallery shows how an item is presented for sale. Warehouse inspection photos show an item after it arrives. A similar-looking product or historical image is not proof of the condition of your own order.
Product pages in this directory identify the seller gallery separately. When verified QC data is missing, the page says so rather than labeling listing photos as an inspection.

sections.heading: A practical inspection sequence
paragraphs: Start with the product, color and size you ordered. Look at the overall shape before zooming into seams, closures, printing and visible damage. For fit, compare useful measurements with a garment you already own.

If an important detail is not visible, ask USFans whether an additional photo or measurement is available and review any charge before requesting it. A photograph cannot establish every material property, internal function or long-term durability.

sections.heading: Resolve uncertainty before parcel submission
paragraphs: Keep the order number, selected option and relevant photo together when contacting support. Describe the specific mismatch instead of only saying that the item looks wrong.

USFans provides inspection and after-sales information in its Help Center. Seller return conditions and the item’s current status affect the available next step; do not assume every issue can be resolved after international shipment.

guide.title: Your first USFans order, in focus.
guide.intro: Finding an item, purchasing it and shipping a parcel are separate decisions. Use the official workflow and check the details at each handoff.

sections.heading: 1. Start from the correct listing
paragraphs: Browse the spreadsheet or use a product keyword. Open a listing to review its available photos and marketplace item ID. The purchase button takes that item to USFans with the appropriate marketplace code.
Use the live USFans page to confirm the selected option, price and seller information. A directory price is a reference, not an order quotation.

sections.heading: 2. Register and review the item order
paragraphs: Create your account on the USFans registration page. Account details, payment information and order management stay with USFans; this directory does not collect them.

Select the precise color, size and quantity. Review the item amount and any domestic delivery charge before submitting the order. If a link or option does not load correctly, resolve it before payment.

sections.heading: 3. Inspect the warehouse result
paragraphs: After the seller dispatches the item and it reaches the warehouse, review the order’s inspection information and photos. Confirm that the item and option match your order.
For uncertain dimensions or a visible mismatch, use the available support process before submitting the parcel. Keep written notes and relevant photos tied to the order number.

sections.heading: 4. Choose the parcel and route
paragraphs: Select the stored items you want to send, confirm your destination details and compare the routes actually available for those goods. Weight, packed dimensions, item restrictions and packaging choices can affect the options.
Review the shipping payment and any selected services in your account. After dispatch, follow the parcel’s tracking information; an estimate is not a guaranteed arrival date.

shipping.title: Plan the parcel, not just the price.
shipping.intro: An item’s listed price is only one part of the total. Review domestic delivery, parcel weight, packed dimensions and the actual route quote before committing to international shipping.

sections.heading: Item cost and shipping are separate
paragraphs: The directory displays an estimated USD item price derived from the source listing. It does not include a guaranteed international shipping quote. Seller prices, selected variants and exchange rates can change.

USFans’ beginner guide describes item purchasing and international parcel submission as separate stages. Review the amounts shown at each stage instead of treating the first payment as the final delivered cost.

sections.heading: Use actual weight and packed dimensions
paragraphs: A light but bulky parcel can be priced differently from a compact parcel of the same weight. Routes may use actual weight, volumetric weight or other billing rules. Apply the rule shown for the route you are considering.
The official guide explains that shipping deposits use estimates and that final charges depend on the carrier’s checked weight and dimensions. Keep any estimate and the eventual parcel bill distinct.

sections.heading: Choose packaging with the item in mind
paragraphs: Compare available removal, protection and reinforcement options against the goods you are sending. Removing bulky packaging may reduce volume, but packaging also protects shape and surfaces.

Consolidation can simplify parcel planning, but more items in one box does not automatically produce the lowest total. Different product restrictions, route limits and delivery priorities may favor different groupings.

sections.heading: Check the live route information
paragraphs: Use the routes and services offered for your actual destination and goods. Review the quoted cost, tracking service and stated estimate together; there is no single shipping time or per-kilogram price for every order.

If a tracking event is unclear, compare the USFans parcel record with the carrier information and contact support with the parcel number. Avoid treating a temporary lack of scans as proof that the parcel is lost.
